messages:
Maria (Support): Heads-up: Sales flagged a high-traffic launch for Acme Corp; they need a temporary pass-through to allow ~6x normal QPS on org:acme for ~48h. Any objections to a temporary exemption? Customer is going live 10:00 PST tomorrow.
Sam (Sales): Confirming — they hit limits in staging last night. Urgent for the launch, minimal friction requested.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Quick architecture note: two options I see — (A) a TTL'd allowlist row that bumps per-org quota; (B) a runtime 'burst-pass-through' route with soft-throttling + telemetry. A is faster, B is safer for billing/backpressure.
Ryan (Eng-SRE): +1 A is fastest to implement. If we do A, cap absolute tokens/sec so one org can't blow the cluster. Need audit log + automatic expiry.
Maria (Support): Sales prefers no SDK or client changes. Must be platform-side only.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I can add an internal admin action: create temporary exception with {org_id, qps_delta, max_tokens_per_sec, expires_at, reason, created_by}. We'll validate and emit an audit event.
Sam (Sales): Can we avoid manual DB edits? Sales needs a one-click in Console or we do it for them.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll add a console flow (internal only) that posts to our admin API. Also add a flag so exceptions are visible in the Console UI and dashboards.
Ryan (Eng-SRE): Please also tag telemetry with `temp_exempt=true` and emit a metric `exempt_requests_total`. We'll create an alert if token/sec > 150% of baseline or if error-rate increases.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Proposed quick API (internal only):
```
POST /internal/exceptions
{
  "org_id": "acme",
  "qps_delta": 5.0,
  "max_tokens_per_sec": 2500,
  "expires_at": "2025-06-02T18:00:00Z",
  "reason": "launch support",
  "created_by": "maria"
}
```
Response will return `exception_id` and we store TTL in DB.
Sam (Sales): Customer actually wants full 6x immediately. Any chance to avoid staged rollout?
Priya (Eng-Platform): I prefer staged: start at 2x, monitor 15m, then step to 6x. Safer for infra and easier to rollback. Can support pre-approvals for Sales.
Maria (Support): Sales ok with staged approach if it's automated.
Ryan (Eng-SRE): We can implement a simple step-up job: if error-rate < 0.5% and token/sec < threshold, then increase qps_delta. We'll also emit an incident if latency > 200ms p95.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll implement the internal API + console flow today and enable pre-approve for this request. Setting default cap to 2x and step to 6x after 15m checks unless @eng-oncall vetoes.
quota-bot: Created temporary exception id=tx-891, org=acme, created_by=maria, expires=1765299856 (48h).
Maria (Support): Great, please add a dashboard link in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng-Platform): Dashboard link: https://console.internal/allowlist/tx-891 — filters: org=acme, tag=temp_exempt=true. I'll post PR and changelog to #eng-releases.
Ryan (Eng-SRE): I'll add runbook note and watch the dashboard for the first 2 hours. If anything spikes, we'll revert TTL to immediate expiry.
Sam (Sales): Thanks team — ping me when fully set so I can tell the customer.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Will do. PR description: "internal: add temporary exception API + console flow + telemetry tags + step-up job" — will include unit tests and e2e sim.
